close_reason: Fixed in f1a7341 (docs only): doc-comment now reflects the workspace-architectural decision space accurately. The original 'mixing it with blob_id is not a realistic mistake' rationale was retired; the actual constraint (canonical-template parity with jmap-mail-types, which also does not depend on jmap-cid-types) is now documented inline. The dep-policy question is tracked at bd:JMAP-tzvc as a workspace-wide architectural decision.
description:
crate-jmap-chat-types/src/message.rs:123 declares `Attachment.sha256: String` with a doc-comment that explicitly justifies the un-typed choice: "A newtype without validation would add type-tagging overhead for a field that already has a distinct name; mixing it with blob_id is not a realistic mistake." That justification was written before `jmap-cid-types` existed in the workspace.

Workspace AGENTS.md (Crate Map and Dependency Tree sections) now lists `jmap-cid-types` as the canonical home for the `Sha256` typed wire shape ("lowercase hex, 64 chars"). It was added precisely so blob-attachment-style integrity hashes have a typed home with validation.

Idiomatic Rust: replace `pub sha256: String` with `pub sha256: jmap_cid_types::Sha256` (gated on jmap-cid-types being declared as a dep of jmap-chat-types). Invalid sha256 strings (wrong length, uppercase hex, non-hex characters) become unrepresentable in the type rather than relying on every consumer's defensive runtime check. The doc-comment's "realistic mistake" framing is the wrong test — the real cost is each downstream server having to re-validate, with the failure mode being a silent-acceptance bug if any one of them forgets.

Cost: adds a path-dep from jmap-chat-types → jmap-cid-types (a sibling type crate, no async, allowed under jmap-chat-types/AGENTS.md "Sibling Crate Congruence" rules — but explicit user confirmation may be required because chat-types currently lists only jmap-types, serde, serde_json as allowed deps). If adding the dep is undesired, the alternative is to keep the field as `String` and add a runtime validator with a clear `from_str` constructor. Either is better than the current "trust the wire" posture.

Update the stale rationale doc-comment when fixing.
title: Attachment.sha256 is String; workspace now has typed jmap-cid-types::Sha256 newtype — rationale-not-to-use is stale
